objective: Determine the finite-time cascade response to replacing the inherited BEQ-total/normalized-BED-shape ionization representation by a full BED model whose slow-electron distribution and total rate use the same primary-source oscillator strength. Preserve the inherited source, bath, transport, excitation effective model, and all global gates.

tier_routing.adoption: Prospective operational routing only; no scientific authority imported from the parallel branch.
tier_routing.Astra: theory, source/domain, physical model, contract, independent final review, admission/publication decision
tier_routing.lower_tier: mechanical implementation, targeted execution, evidence assembly and NCP scripts under this frozen contract; actual worker model recorded without asserting Astra identity

fixed_physics.source: Unchanged parent ElectronSource; proton birth support 1-4 MeV, selected electron energy 0.1-900 eV, Q_e(W,t)=t A(W), initially empty, T=1e10 s.
fixed_physics.bath: Exactly inherited nH=140 m^-3, YHe=.248, xHII=xHeII=.01, xHeIII=0, Tgas=100 K prescribed bath; no feedback.
fixed_physics.transport: Reuse hash-checked parent Cascade unchanged, including classical/quantum Coulomb min closure with quantum_constant=0, projection, source quadrature, time propagator, and ledgers.
fixed_physics.excitation: Exactly the same 27 checked CCC raw tables and native first-zero effective costs, linear interpolation, native zero rows, no extrapolation. Their spectroscopic/Hamiltonian interpretation is separately audited; no relabeling or energy-axis shift in this comparison.
fixed_physics.ionization_daughters: W and E-B-W, 0<=W<=(E-B)/2; one extra electron, binding energy B retained separately.
fixed_physics.atomic_change_only: Replace AtomicData.ionization objects with compatible full-BED ionization objects. Parent science files must not be edited.

full_BED.moment_Q_diagnostic: Qdf=(2/N)*integral_0^infinity g(w)/(1+w) dw; diagnostic only, NOT substituted into the BEQ total
full_BED.normalization: No external physical BEQ/BEB renormalization. Parent daughter quadrature normalization is retained only as a measured numerical correction to this same integral.

HI.D_implementation: FP64 Gauss-Legendre order128 on the finite slow-half interval, checked at independent 50-digit oracle points. No old polynomial outside its validity range.
HI.source: Rohrmann and Vera Rueda 2022 arXiv:2208.02111v2 Eqs5,9,10 and Table1. epsilon=1+w in Rydberg units; nonrelativistic Coulomb dipole oscillator strength, not exact electron-impact scattering.

HeI.source: Kim, Johnson and Rudd 2000 Phys Rev A61,034702 Eqs1-6, DOI10.1103/PhysRevA.61.034702; original printed precision
HeI.transcription_resolution: Additive binary plus dipole formula as NIST Eq3 and the integrated total identity. Do not claim a discovered publisher erratum for the multiplication glyph in the PDF.

full_BED.numerical_stability: Use expm1 for exponential differences, atan(sqrt(w))/sqrt(w) continuous value1 at w=0, and exact threshold limit. Do not suppress negative/nonfinite density or silently clip physical rates.
full_BED.legacy_interpretation: NIST explicitly allows normalized BED sharing with a separate BEB/BEQ total. The inherited hybrid is a distinct conditional representation, not proven algebraically invalid. Q=.8841 lineage and current CGI equivalence remain unverified.

numerics.same_operator_terminal: One sparse resolvent per new grid for the inherited output vector; no time evolution outside T.
numerics.paired_comparison: Compare each new grid to matching saved legacy R002 grid. Do not rerun unchanged legacy transport locally.
numerics.diagnostic: For each nonzero paired delta Delta, report r=abs(Delta_fine-Delta_coarse)/abs(Delta_fine). Empirically resolved iff r<1/3 and signs agree. This is a two-grid diagnostic, not a certified error bound or significance test; unresolved rows remain unresolved.
numerics.off_or_time_oracles: Do not rerun unchanged parent suites. Check changed atomic domain and generator/propagated ledgers on the new candidate; source/propagator validity inherited with scope.

resources.admission: Record actual cpuset/cgroup quota and memory current/limit, actual BLAS threads and process/RSS; reserve max(12.5% of bounded memory,1GiB), include coordinator; stop before large allocation if unavailable.
resources.first_failure: Preserve complete actual exception/stderr/exit and input/code identities. Missing dependency before numerical execution is operational and does not consume a transport call.
resources.one_authorized_repair: One targeted contract-preserving implementation/interface/shape bug or quadrature-order increase up to256 if an unchanged atomic integral tolerance fails; retain first run. No physical coefficient, energy cost, cutoff, tolerance or grid change. Anything beyond returns to Astra.

ncp_handoff.self_contained: Bundle NCP start prompt, frozen contract, code, all parent source/raw inputs and saved comparison evidence, source citations, dependency specification, resource admission, exact commands and return collector. No additional user attachment required.
ncp_handoff.next_bounded_task: Conditional paired third-grid refinement at (3200,6400), full BED and legacy BEQ/BED sequentially, matched against saved4800 results, only if next DAG admits this numerical task. Exact same physics/precision/tolerances. No64-rank sweep.
ncp_handoff.hardware: Advertised64CPU128GB is context only. Detect actual affinity/quota, RAM, free disk and live load; one process with thread1 by default, reserve12.5% minimum1GiB. Do not assume remote credentials from ChatGPT connector access.

claim_ceiling: Source-defined coherent nonrelativistic full-BED conditional cascade comparison at fixed bath and selected source. Numeric convergence and rate-shape identity do not certify physical cross sections, full atomic completeness, spectral threshold accuracy, or production history.
completion: Candidate passes targeted contract, distinct final Astra decision maker reviews frozen packet, report/DAG/state/failures/handoff updated, additive research publication and dual backups completed with executable NCP prompt inside.
